missions.title: First Light
missions.description: Inspect three different candlestick formations in the Archive or interactive exhibit pods to build your foundational chart literacy.

dialogue.offered: Welcome to Candle City, initiate. Price charts speak in candles. Before stepping onto the trading floor, you must learn to read the basic formations. Inspect at least 3 distinct patterns in our Archive or exhibit pods.
dialogue.in_progress: You are making progress. Continue inspecting candle formations across the district. Return to me once you have examined 3 distinct patterns.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Outstanding work! You have begun deciphering the language of the market. Claim your reward and prepare for deeper drills.
dialogue.completed: You have mastered the First Light drill. Check with Instructor Val at the Blitz Arena when you're ready for speed drills.

missions.title: Rapid Eye
missions.description: Step into the Candle Blitz Arena and complete one full 10-round candlestick recognition match under time pressure.

dialogue.offered: Speed and precision separate real traders from amateurs. Enter the Candle Blitz Arena in the northeast sector and complete a full 10-round match.
dialogue.in_progress: The arena is waiting. Head to the Candle Blitz Terminal and finish all 10 rounds of recognition targets.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Impressive reaction times! You held your focus under the countdown timer. Here is your combat drill reward.
dialogue.completed: Your reflexes are sharp. Keep practicing in Blitz mode to push your recognition accuracy and combo multipliers even higher.

missions.title: Pattern Hunter
missions.description: Correctly identify 10 candlestick patterns across your training drills and arena target sessions.

dialogue.offered: A true hunter never misidentifies their target. Correctly recognize 10 distinct formations during your drills to prove your pattern recall.
dialogue.in_progress: Keep hunting! Lock onto the key features—wicks, bodies, and color biases. Reach 10 correct identifications.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Target confirmed! 10 accurate identifications locked in. You are developing a disciplined trading eye.
dialogue.completed: 10 confirmed targets down! You're ready to tackle more complex multi-candle formations.

missions.title: Candle Scholar
missions.description: Expand your chart vocabulary by exploring at least 20 unique candlestick patterns in the Master Candlestick Archive.

dialogue.offered: There are 44 canonical candlestick formations in our master encyclopedia. Single candles, dual tweezers, and triple star patterns. Expand your knowledge by studying at least 20 unique formations.
dialogue.in_progress: Knowledge is leverage. Open the Candle Archive and examine single, double, and triple candle setups until you reach 20 patterns.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Exceptional scholarly dedication! 20 unique patterns committed to memory. Take your World XP and mastery bonus.
dialogue.completed: You are now a recognized Candle Scholar in this district. Continue towards full 44-pattern mastery!

missions.title: Context Matters
missions.description: Visit the Context Chamber or Mistake Lab and complete an interactive analysis challenge on trend location and fakeouts.

dialogue.offered: A hammer at resistance is not a buy signal—it's a trap. Patterns only have meaning when read inside macro trend context. Complete a session at the Context Chamber to learn proper confirmation rules.
dialogue.in_progress: Head to the Context Chamber in the southwest sector. Test your ability to separate valid setups from market fakeouts.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Superb analysis! You understand that location and confluence validate the pattern. Here is your reward.
dialogue.completed: Always check the prevailing trend before pulling the trigger. Context is king.

missions.title: City Explorer
missions.description: Physically navigate Candle City and interact with 5 distinct district stations, pods, or arena terminals.

dialogue.offered: Welcome to Strativo World's premier candlestick training ground. Get your bearings by visiting at least 5 different facilities across Candle City.
dialogue.in_progress: Walk the district avenues! Visit the Archive, Recognition Range, Blitz Arena, Context Chamber, and Mistake Lab.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: District mapped! You know every corner of Candle City. Take your Explorer commendation.
dialogue.completed: You know the layout like the back of your hand. Use all facilities to hone your trading edge.
